name: outro-1-city
notes: Story panels between and after the rooms.

slots.subject: A city of gears and steam in warm evening light, everything running: street lamps lit, a tram crossing a stone bridge, a big wheel turning, a water wheel in a canal, a clock tower on a terrace with thin steam plumes. Small distant crowds on the squares.
slots.camera: High isometric bird's-eye view, parallel projection.
slots.composition: The city fills the picture edge to edge.
